p: have me in derision: That is, my estate is changed and while before the ancient men were glad to revere me, the young men now contemn me.
dogs of my flock: Meaning to be my shepherds or to keep my dogs.
perished: That is, their fathers died of hunger before they came to age.
driven forth from among men: Job shows that those who mocked him in his affliction were like their fathers, wicked and lewd fellows, such as he here describes.
song: They make songs of me, and mock my misery.
cord: God has taken from me the force, credit, and authority with which I kept them in subjection.
they have also let loose the: He said that the young men when they saw him, hid themselves as in Job 29:8, and now in his misery they were impudent and licentious.
ways of their destruction: That is, they sought by all means how they might destroy me.
helper: They need no one to help them.
desolation they rolled themselves upon me: By my calamity they took an opportunity against me.
poured out upon me: My life fails me, and I am as half dead.
My bones are pierced in me: Meaning sorrow.
He hath cast me into the: That is, God has brought me into contempt.
cruel to me: He does not speak this way to accuse God, but to declare the vehemency of his affliction, by which he was carried beside himself.
wind: He compares his afflictions to a tempest or whirlwind.
to the grave: No one can deliver me from there, though they lament my death.
evil came unto me: Instead of comforting they mocked me.
without the sun: Not delighting in any worldly thing, no not so much as in the use of the sun.
and I cried in the congregation: Lamenting them that were in affliction and moving others to pity them.
dragons: I am like the wild beasts that desire solitary places.
heat: With the heat of affliction.
